parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of Cloud Firewall.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response.

Valid values:

*   **zh** (default)
*   **en**

parameters.name: Operate
parameters.description:
The operation type.

*   Set the value to open.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw update-postpay-user-vpc-status --instance-id cfw_elasticity_public_cn-000000000000 --operate open --lang zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw UpdatePostpayUserVpcStatus --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'cfw_elasticity_public_cn-000000000000' --Lang zh --Operate open
